sources.title: EIA930 reporting instructions
sources.supports: Hourly integrated MW, nearest integer, UTC hour ending. FLOW is net metered tie line flow, positive outward from reporting BA. Bilateral codes identify directly physically connected BAs. This supports hour-ending minus1hour and negative NYIS-to-HQT as imports to NY. It does not provide a Chateauguay/Cedars split.

sources.title: NYISO PAR Flow Direction Diagrams
sources.supports: Existing visual verification receipt establishes positive PTID25118/L33P/PS33 and PTID25119/L34P/PS34 as IESO StLawrence230kV to NYISO Moses230kV, effective2024-12-03. Current document was published2026-07-17 but explicitly states the2024effective date. No observation-fit sign is used.

sources.title: NYISO Phase Angle Regulator Flows public P34 archive
sources.supports: Public daily and monthly source archive for actual PAR flows. Native2025 CSV fields Timestamp, PointID and Flow(MWH) are preserved. The public index inspected does not establish preceding-versus-following sample-interval semantics.

sources.title: NYISO Summer2025 Operating Study
sources.supports: Identifies Chateauguay-Massena MSC7040 and Dennison ties. Distinguishes NYCA-delivery limit from larger7040 real-time capability with wheel-through; lists separate Cedars/Dennison capabilities. These are operating limits and connection evidence, not hourly meter telemetry, allocation fractions or complete MosesSouth meter membership.

sources.title: Hydro Quebec New York market connections
sources.supports: Primary history identifies LesCedres-Dennison intertie and Chateauguay-Marcy765kV connection with ChateauguayDC conversion. It does not validate2025hourly interchange measurements or the reduced model's bus-level distribution.

sources.title: Hydro Quebec imports and exports by market with wheeling
sources.supports: Dataset description states hourly updates, net imports/exports including transits, only48hours temporal coverage, and extraction/modeling from public sources external to HydroQuebec. It is not an independent annual2025counterparty meter series.

sources.title: NYISO P930B daily EIA submission index
sources.supports: Direct NYISO daily submissions are a possible same-respondent version crosscheck. The rolling public index is not a complete2025archive as of2026-10-15 and has not been used as a replacement.
